description.value: Deer Lake Wonton House is a Chinese restaurant in North Vancouver offering indoor dining. It provides a casual meal stop for touring cyclists in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch failed (status=400), so all amenity claims rely on OSM tags alone. OSM confirms this is an active restaurant (amenity=restaurant, cuisine=chinese, looks_closed=false) with indoor seating and no smoking. However, OSM tags contain no information about bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist amenities, so these default to null. The business exists at a real address in North Vancouver with no explicit closure markers.
